title: Clean a Web Terminal testnet market
description: Web Terminal variant: on testnet only, cancel the open orders and close the position of one explicitly reserved account/market, signed in the harness by the fixture account (outside the UI and the wallet log), then independently assert both absent. Refuses mainnet and account-wide cleanup; caller confirmation does not reserve the market.

clean_market.intent: Cancel the reserved market's open orders and close its position on testnet with the fixture signer

assert_no_positions.intent: Independently assert no position remains in the reserved market

assert_no_orders.intent: Independently assert no open order remains in the reserved market

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for this task.

exclusive_testnet_market.description: Confirm exclusive task ownership of the account/market on testnet. It does not reserve it.
